name: Genesis
description: Creates new agents on disk after explicit confirmation

name: Polaris
description: Router + planning gate: decides USE_AGENT / CREATE_AGENT / ASK_USER via NebulonMind and runs the pre-execution planning step (planning.py lives here)

name: Kepler
description: Reusable planning agent: creates implementation plans, roadmaps and designs for any task or stack. Route planning, roadmap and design requests here — not implementation, testing, or review.

name: ResearchAgent
description: Research specialist: investigates topics, compares options, and reports findings. Route research and investigation requests here.

name: Apollo
description: Implementation specialist: writes, edits and fixes code in the task workspace, then verifies with tests. Route here for ANY write, fix or build request — even when testing is mentioned, it handles its own verification.

name: Pulsar
description: Testing specialist: runs existing suites (pytest/compileall) and reports pass/fail; writes regression tests on request. Does NOT implement features or fix production code — route those to Apollo.

name: Astra
description: Read-only code reviewer: inspects code and reports ranked findings with file:line references. Never modifies files — route any write or edit request to Apollo.
